theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Utilities (+0.32%) and Technology (-0.05%) led the market today, while Materials (-0.92%) and Health Care (-0.85%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.30%, defensives -0.44%, and value/cyclicals -0.56% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.31%, Dow -0.55%, Nasdaq -0.20% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.82%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 1.80% to 16.36, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.38% to $4,180.00, crude oil was little changed at $90.53, and bitcoin slipped 0.34% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
